phases.title: Phase 1 — Story: the chapters
phases.blurb: Play the story. Chapter trophies unlock in order; the gold finale trophy (id 7) ends the story, so clear story-tied clean-up before it if you want one playthrough.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Story: key missions
phases.blurb: Named story missions that carry their own trophies. They unlock as the story reaches them — tick them off as they pop.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Strangers & side strands
phases.blurb: Mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strands can become unavailable as the story moves on, so finish these before the final mission.

phases.title: Phase 4 — Activities & challenges
phases.blurb: Races, drone races, fishing, bowling, the shooting range, stunts and the challenge list. Mostly free-roam content you can grind any time.

phases.title: Phase 5 — Partner & free-roam feats
phases.blurb: Robberies, escapes and combat feats — several need your partner beside you in free roam, so do those while both partners are available.

phases.title: Phase 6 — Collectibles & exploration
phases.blurb: Cards, meditation spots, vehicles and every named area of Leonida. Pure clean-up: sweep the map region by region.

phases.title: Phase 7 — Economy & miscellaneous
phases.blurb: Money goals (laundering, spending, garages) and the odd one-off moments scattered around the state.

phases.title: Phase 8 — Clean-up & the platinum
phases.blurb: 100% completion, then the platinum itself. If anything is left, the filters in this tracker will find it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guidance: Earn every other trophy in the game. This unlocks automatically once the other 54 are yours — use the filters in this tracker to hunt down the last stragglers.
sources: Official GTA VI trophy list (PlayStation trophy data, as listed 2026-11-18) — name, description and grade.
